explanations.LOGIN_SUCCESS: Someone signed in to your account with its password or a sign-in code.
explanations.LOGIN_FAILED: Someone tried to sign in to your account, but the password or code was wrong. A few of these are usually a typo.
explanations.LOGIN_LOCKED: After too many wrong attempts, signing in to your account was blocked for a while to keep it safe.
explanations.LOGOUT: A session on your account was signed out.
explanations.SESSION_CREATED: Your account was signed in on a device or browser, which started a new session.
explanations.SESSION_REVOKED: One session on your account was signed out, by you or because it was no longer safe to keep.
explanations.SESSION_ALL_REVOKED: Your account was signed out on all other devices.
explanations.PASSWORD_SET: A password was added to your account.
explanations.PASSWORD_CHANGED: The password for your account was changed.
explanations.PASSWORD_RESET_REQUESTED: A code to reset your password was sent to your email address.
explanations.PASSWORD_RESET_COMPLETED: Your password was reset with a code from your email, and you were signed out everywhere.
explanations.PASSKEY_REGISTERED: A passkey was added, so you can sign in with your device instead of a password.
explanations.PASSKEY_USED: Someone signed in to your account with one of its passkeys.
explanations.PASSKEY_REMOVED: A passkey was removed and can no longer be used to sign in.
explanations.PASSKEY_COUNTER_MISMATCH: A passkey reported something unexpected, which can mean it was copied. The sign-in was refused.
explanations.MFA_ENABLED: Signing in now also asks for a code from your authenticator app.
explanations.MFA_DISABLED: Signing in no longer asks for a code from your authenticator app.
explanations.MFA_FACTOR_ENROLLED: An authenticator app was linked to your account.
explanations.MFA_FACTOR_VERIFIED: A code from your authenticator app was confirmed.
explanations.MFA_FACTOR_REVOKED: An authenticator app was removed from your account.
explanations.RECOVERY_CODES_GENERATED: A new set of recovery codes was made. The old codes no longer work.
explanations.RECOVERY_CODE_USED: Someone signed in with one of your recovery codes instead of an authenticator code. That code can't be used again.
explanations.STEP_UP_REQUIRED: Before a sensitive change, you were asked to confirm it's you with a code by email.
explanations.STEP_UP_COMPLETED: A code by email confirmed it was you, which allowed a sensitive change for a while.
explanations.EMAIL_ADDED: An email address was added to your account and sent a confirmation link.
explanations.EMAIL_VERIFIED: An email address on your account was confirmed.
explanations.EMAIL_REMOVED: An email address was removed from your account.
explanations.EMAIL_PRIMARY_CHANGED: A different email address became your account's main address, for sign-in and messages.
explanations.ACCOUNT_UPDATED: A setting or detail on your account was changed.
explanations.ACCOUNT_DELETED: Your account was set to be deleted. It can be restored for 30 days.
explanations.ACCOUNT_REACTIVATED: Your account was turned back on after being deactivated or deleted.
explanations.OAUTH_CONSENT_GRANTED: An app received access to your account with Ordnary ID.
explanations.OAUTH_CONSENT_REVOKED: An app no longer has access to your account.
explanations.OAUTH_TOKEN_ISSUED: An app you use with Ordnary ID got a new sign-in token.
explanations.OAUTH_TOKEN_REVOKED: A sign-in token for an app was revoked.
explanations.SUSPICIOUS_NEW_LOCATION: Your account was used from a place it hasn't been used from before.
explanations.SUSPICIOUS_NEW_DEVICE: Your account was used on a device it hasn't been used on before.
explanations.SUSPICIOUS_IMPOSSIBLE_TRAVEL: Your account was used from two places too far apart for one person to travel between in that time.
explanations.NOTIFICATION_PREFERENCE_CHANGED: Which emails Ordnary may send you was changed.
explanations.NOTIFICATION_UNSUBSCRIBE_LINK_USED: An unsubscribe link in an email turned off a kind of email.
explanations.PRIVACY_REQUEST_FILED: A request to object to or restrict processing of your data was filed.
explanations.PRIVACY_REQUEST_RESOLVED: Ordnary handled your request to object to or restrict processing.
explanations.DSAR_FILED: A request about your data (access, correction, deletion or a copy) was filed.
explanations.DSAR_REJECTED: Ordnary declined your data request; the email explains why.
explanations.RISK_REVIEW_REQUESTED: A review of an automated decision on your account was requested.
explanations.RISK_REVIEW_RESOLVED: A person at Ordnary reviewed an automated decision on your account.
